question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

In the flesh
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"in the flesh"** is used when you want to say that you are seeing someone in person that you have heard about or seen in pictures, movies, TV, etc.
 
• **It means** to see or meet someone in person or in real life. (व्यक्तिगत रूप से)
 
• **In bodily form: **This phrase means in physical or tangible form, implying the actual presence of a person.(शारीरिक रूप में)
 
• This is the **correct choice **as it expresses the meaning of the idiom "in the flesh".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'In bodily form'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine the given options:
 
 
• **To be near death: **This phrase suggests a state of being close to dying or experiencing a life-threatening situation. (मौत के करीब होना)
 
• **To talk:** This phrase simply refers to the act of engaging in speech or conversation.(बातचीत करना)
 
• **To get a tattoo: **This phrase refers to the act of getting a design inked on the skin, which is unrelated to the given idiom.(तत्तू बनवाना)

The **correct answer** is 'Option 1'.</stron
